title: On the Toda hierarchy for the stationary theory of the tube with negative contact orders
summary: We construct a master $2$-Toda tau sequence for the stationary relative theory of $(\PP^1,0,\infty)$ with any fixed finite lists of negative contacts. The negative-contact blocks are encoded by finite products of exponentials of infinite-wedge Lie algebra elements, with the block at $\infty$ taken as the adjoint of the entire corresponding left block. After adjoining independent positive-profile Toda times, the resulting charged-vacuum matrix elements form a genuine $2$-Toda tau sequence.
